text_en: Does not wisdom call, and does not understanding raise her voice?
text_cn: 智慧不是在呼唤，明智不是在发出她的呼声吗？

text_en: On the heights, beside the way, at the crossroads she takes her stand;
text_cn: 她站在高岗上，站在通衢大道上，

text_en: beside the gates in front of the town, at the entrance of the portals she cries out:
text_cn: 她在城门口，在城入口处大声喊说：

text_en: “To you, O people, I call, and my cry is to all that live.
text_cn: 人呀！我在向你们呼唤，我在对人子发出呼声：

text_en: O simple ones, learn prudence; acquire intelligence, you who lack it.
text_cn: 幼稚的人，你们应学习机智；愚昧的人，你们应学习聪明。

text_en: Hear, for I will speak noble things, and from my lips will come what is right;
text_cn: 你们且听，因为我要讲论卓绝的事，开口述说正直的事。

text_en: for my mouth will utter truth; wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
text_cn: 的确，我的口只畅谈真理，我厌恶虚诈的唇舌。

text_en: All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.
text_cn: 凡我口述的，无不正直，毫无歪曲或乖僻。

text_en: They are all straight to one who understands and right to those who find knowledge.
text_cn: 我的话为明白的人是诚实的，为有智识的人是正确的。

text_en: Take my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold;
text_cn: 你们应听取我的教训，而不要银子；应汲取智识，而不取纯金；

text_en: for wisdom is better than jewels, and all that you may desire cannot compare with her.
text_cn: 因为智慧胜过任何珍珠，任何可贪恋的事都不能与她伦比。

text_en: I, wisdom, live with prudence, and I attain knowledge and discretion.
text_cn: 我——智慧——与机智同居，拥有知识和见识。

text_en: The fear of the Lord is hatred of evil. Pride and arrogance and the way of evil and perverted speech I hate.
text_cn: 敬畏上主，就是憎恨邪恶傲慢骄横，邪恶的行径和欺诈的口舌，我都憎恶。

text_en: I have good advice and sound wisdom; I have insight, I have strength.
text_cn: 机谋才智，属我所有；聪明勇敢，亦属于我。

text_en: By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is just;
text_cn: 藉着我，君王执政，元首秉公行义；

text_en: by me rulers rule, and nobles, all who govern rightly.
text_cn: 藉着我，统治者统治，王侯治理邦土。

text_en: I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find me.
text_cn: 我爱那爱我的人；凡寻求我的，必找着我。

text_en: Riches and honor are with me, enduring wealth and prosperity.
text_cn: 富贵荣誉，恒产正义，都属我有。

text_en: My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold, and my yield than choice silver.
text_cn: 我的果实，胜过黄金纯金；我的出产，比净银还要宝贵。

text_en: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,
text_cn: 我走在正义的路上，走在公平的路上，

text_en: endowing with wealth those who love me, and filling their treasuries.
text_cn: 使爱我者获得产业，充满他们的宝库。

text_en: The Lord created me at the beginning of his work, the first of his acts of long ago.
text_cn: 上主自始即拿我作他行动的起始，作他作为的开端：

text_en: Ages ago I was set up, at the first, before the beginning of the earth.
text_cn: 大地还没有形成以前，远自太古，从无始我已被立；

text_en: When there were no depths I was brought forth, when there were no springs abounding with water.
text_cn: 深渊还没有存在，水泉还没有涌出以前，我已受生；

text_en: Before the mountains had been shaped, before the hills, I was brought forth—
text_cn: 山岳还没有奠定，丘陵还没有存在以前，我已受生。

text_en: when he had not yet made earth and fields, or the world’s first bits of soil.
text_cn: 那时，上主还没有创造大地、原野、和世上土壤的原质；

text_en: When he established the heavens, I was there, when he drew a circle on the face of the deep,
text_cn: 当他建立高天时，我已在场；当他在深渊之上划出穹苍时，

text_en: when he made firm the skies above, when he established the fountains of the deep,
text_cn: 当他上使穹苍稳立，下使渊源固定时，

text_en: when he assigned to the sea its limit, so that the waters might not transgress his command, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,
text_cn: 当他为沧海划定界限，令水不要越境，给大地奠定基础时，

text_en: then I was beside him, like a master worker; and I was daily his delight, rejoicing before him always,
text_cn: 我已在他身旁，充作技师。那时，我天天是他的喜悦，不断在他前欢跃，

text_en: rejoicing in his inhabited world and delighting in the human race.
text_cn: 欢跃于尘寰之间，乐与世人共处。

text_en: “And now, my children, listen to me: happy are those who keep my ways.
text_cn: 那么，我儿，你们且听我：遵循我道路的人是有福的。

text_en: Hear instruction and be wise, and do not neglect it.
text_cn: 你们该听从教训，做一智慧人，不要把她抛弃。

text_en: Happy is the one who listens to me, watching daily at my gates, waiting beside my doors.
text_cn: 凡听从我言，天天在我门前守候，在我门框旁侍立的人，是有福的。

text_en: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the Lord ;
text_cn: 因为谁找到我，便是找到生命，他必由上主获得恩宠。

text_en: but those who miss me injure themselves; all who hate me love death. ”
text_cn: 但是那得罪我的，等于伤害自己；凡憎恨我的，是自找死亡。
